title: Understanding the Odds
text: The odds of survival for a male passenger is given by the model as $$m$$. This is calculated based on the logistic regression equation.

title: Logistic Regression Equation
text: The logistic regression equation is given by: $$\ln\left(odds\right)=intercept+beta1 age+beta2 sex$$. Here, sex is a binary variable (0 for female, $$1$$ for male).

title: Calculating Odds for Females
text: For a female passenger, the sex variable is $$0$$. Substitute this into the logistic regression equation to find the odds for females.

title: Substitute Values
text: Substitute the values into the logistic regression equation: $$\ln\left(f\right)=intercept+beta1 age+0beta2$$.

title: Relate Male and Female Odds
text: Use the relationship between male and female odds: $$f={me}^{beta2}$$.
